case.summary: An investigation was opened following an analyst inquiry into recent card losses lacking a shared device, focusing on transaction 3660263 on card C01727-K2. The flagged charge is part of a series of three online product-C transactions totaling $967.68, marking a sharp departure from the cardholder's standard baseline of in-person product-W purchases. All three transactions routed payments to recipient domain sc.rr.com, which spiked across 16 additional cards in the preceding 30 days after zero occurrences in prior months. While card C01727-K2 also carries five prior confirmed fraud cases, billing region 231 matches the cardholder's home region and no device was recorded. The verdict remains uncertain at an 0.834 fraud probability, prompting case creation, connected card monitoring, and escalation to an analyst.
